sources.summary: Sliding walls, hidden doors and a fold-down bed allow this minimalist apartment in Athens, designed by Greek architect Georgios Apostolopoulos, to be completely reconfigured when friends come to stay. Apostolopoulos was approached by a friend to transform his home in the Stroggyli Polykatoikia apartment block, designed by architect Nikos Despotidis in the city's Kifisia neighbourhood The post Athens apartment features "fluid layout" that adapts to houseguests appeared first on Dezeen .
